children: Like-for-like grocery inflation in the U.K. accelerated to 2.3% for the four weeks to Sept. 6, up from 2.1% in the prior period, according to Worldpanel by Numerator. Though inflation rose modestly last month, it remained far below levels from earlier this year, said Fraser McKevitt, head of retail at the data provider. Meanwhile, there were 18 million fewer trips to the grocers than July's peak of 497 million visits, the report said. This shift was due to the return to school and work, according to the report. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
